hooks.command: command -v m3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[m3-memory] m3 CLI not on PATH. Run: pipx install m3-memory && pipx ensurepath, then m3 setup' >&2; exit 1; }; exec m3 hook claude-session-start

command -v m3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[m3-memory] chatlog NOT captured: m3 CLI not on PATH. Run: pipx install m3-memory && pipx ensurepath' >&2; exit 1; }; m3 hook claude-capture; rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] && exec /bin/sh "$(mcp-memory chatlog hook-path)"; exit "$rc"
